notes.title: Emberdrift Demo Build 0.4.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-Added a new unlockable section to The Cathedral, The Backrooms.  After defeating Rathius and collecting the backrooms key, you will be able to enter this extremely difficult area as a shortcut to getting through The Cathedral.  Beating The Backrooms will net you an Ancient chest with extremely powerful items.

-Added a Memory dialogue to the end of the demo.  This is one of several memories that will be in the final game to tell the story of Emberdrift.

-Implemented projectile pooling for Player Weapons and some boss fights.  This should speed up performance significantly, especially when your weapon has been upgraded with lots of multishot and fire rate upgrades.

notes.title: Emberdrift Playtest 0.2.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
0.2.3

DEV NOTE: As the first boss in the game, Malarax was proving to be an overly difficult hurdle for players to overcome. A new first boss has been added that is less punishing if the player is not yet adept with the movement mechanics.  In the name of Roguelike variety, Malarax will still be encountered 50% of the time, but some changes have been made to hopefully make the fight slightly more forgiving.  I'll keep an eye on this and continue to adjust Malarax as needed.
 
-Added a new first boss, Slujgaard.  Players have a 50/50 chance of encountering this boss or Malarax as the first boss.
-Malarax Nav Mesh Agent now freezes for 1.5 seconds after hitting the player to allow them time to get away.
-Slight adjustments to geometry of Malarax room to allow for easier traversal
-Added a Potion and an Alloy 3 to the pre-boss room to give the player more of a fighting chance.

DEV NOTE: New rooms! Some areas of the cathedral didn't have enough rooms to randomly choose from and you would see repeats frequently.  This will hopefully lessen the number of repeats.
-Added a dozen or so new rooms.

DEV NOTE: Rare and legendary items seem to be encountered too early and too frequently in chests.  Meanwhile Alloy is not encountered frequently enough and playtesters rarely have opportunities to upgrade their weapon.
-Slight rebalancing of loot tables to make rare and legendary items appear less frequently, and alloy appear more frequently
-Some formerly rare items such as Focus Stone and Honing Dagger have been downgraded from rare to uncommon as they are not high impact by themselves.

Other Features/Additions:
-Rathius now has his band mates backing him up.
-Added horizontal movement during Rathius staff spin attack
-Projectile scale now increases with damage bonuses such as items and the House Of Astron Combo buff.  This should make it more clear when your damage is being buffed.
-Added "Shielded" UI floater when attack shielded enemies to make it more clear that they cannot be damaged
-Added "Cooldowns Reset" UI floater text when picking up Blue Orb
-Added a Shield UI floater to indicate that armor was used to negate damage
-Added the ability to ground pound while emberdrifting upside down (i.e. on a loop)
-Adjusted the system that determines whether an enemy will launch you backwards or forwards.  This is primarily concerned with boss fights and enemies with large health pools.  Most of these enemies will now respect your forward velocity if attacked from above and reverse it if attacked from the side.
-Removed Smithing Hammer from Merchant item pool as its UI is conflicting with the Shop UI.


Bugfixes
-Fixed a bug where Crosshair was hidden in shops when using "Always Off" crosshair mode on Mouse and Keyboard
-Fixed a bug putting Goo Pot enemy's hitbox in the wrong place
-Fixed a bug preventing character from flashing red on damage
-Fixed a bug where side exits weren't spawning in one of the mid-upper room sequences
-Fixed a bug allowing Tutorial Ghosts to build combo
-Fixed a bug where Sword Enemy's projectile impact VFX were the wrong color
-Implemented a fix for a bug where shield generating pods were remaining from previous runs.  Not tested.
